items.title: Fencing a Postgres primary that might still be alive
items.summary: Promoting a standby doesn't stop the old Postgres primary from taking writes. Here's how the control plane behind ClickHouse Managed Postgres fences it on bare metal, AWS and GCP, and why the design is fail-open.

items.title: MongoDB CDC connector for ClickPipes is now generally available
items.summary: The MongoDB CDC connector for ClickPipes is now generally available, with parallel snapshotting, structured ingestion into typed columns, lag and resource metrics, and Terraform and OpenAPI support.
